statuses.use: The case is recorded and work has not started.
The case is being worked on.
The next step depends on the customer.
The next step depends on another team or internal resource.

priorities.definition: Critical service outage affecting many customers.
Important service impairment affecting several users, with limited workaround.
Significant but contained issue affecting one customer.
Information request, minor issue or non urgent matter.

slaIntro: First response SLA. SLA means service level agreement, a target for a service response. The due time is the arrival time plus the target.
slaNote: Business hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 18:00. P1 runs on clock time. The next action due time is a separate time, set by the next step in the case.

tags.use: The customer says they paid and the plan has not changed.
The customer has no internet connection.
The problem began with a power cut or the return of power.
The internet works but is slower than the plan.
Many customers in one area are offline.
The customer cannot sign in or change account access.
The customer asks for a change, such as moving an installation.
The customer is dissatisfied or asks for compensation.

teams.name: Customer Support
teams.use: Connection checks, account access, questions, complaints and speed issues.

teams.name: Billing and Payments
teams.use: All payment cases. Checks payment status and activates plans.

teams.name: Finance
teams.use: A back office department. Billing and Payments sends unmatched payment references to Finance.

verification: Confirm identity using two items on record: the account number and installation address.
Share account details after both checks pass.
An unverified caller completes the secure verification form.
Keep passwords out of case records and use the secure route for access requests.
payments: A payment counts when the amount equals the plan price and the reference matches in the payments system. If there is no match, or the status conflicts, send the reference to Finance.

handover.subject: Handover: active cases
handover.text: Each active case needs an owner, next action and next update time at handover. Related estate outage reports use incident NOC-261026-01. Network Operations confirms the restoration estimate before it is shared with customers.
